verdict.rationale: Formant documents a built-in AI assistant in Analytics that can build dashboards for you, and markets plain-language fleet queries that return ML-driven task recommendations for people to approve. Both are single-line mentions, and delegation appears limited to dashboard building and recommendations rather than the assistant executing tasks itself. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what the assistant can do, evidence it executes delegated tasks beyond dashboards and recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
